variants.title: Friction on an incline: bare wooden block on the wooden plank
variants.sample: Bare wooden block on the wooden plank
variants.unknown: the coefficient of static friction μ between the two faces
variants.note: Wood on wood (dry): handbook μs lies between 0.25 and 0.5. This block's own value is the unknown. The block with its facing has a mass of 500 g.

source.title: Serway & Jewett, Physics for Scientists and Engineers, Table 5.1: approximate coefficients of friction (static μs)
